title: Measuring Disparate Outcomes of Content Recommendation Algorithms with Distributional Inequality Metrics
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It evaluates a set of distributional inequality metrics (e.g., Gini index, Atkinson index) to measure disparities in content exposure and engagement (impressions, likes, retweets) on Twitter's algorithmic timeline.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion.
